title: Gulmarg Golf Course - World’s Highest Green Paradise in Kashmir
content:
Gulmarg Golf Course - Where Luxury Meets Nature in the Himalayas

Gulmarg Golf Course is not just a golf destination - it is one of the most scenic and highest golf courses in the world, located in the heart of Kashmir. Surrounded by snow-covered mountains, lush meadows, and tall pine trees, this golf course offers a peaceful and luxurious experience for travelers and nature lovers. Whether you are a golfer, photographer, or traveler seeking calm beauty, Gulmarg Golf Course is a must-visit place in Gulmarg.

Why Gulmarg Golf Course is Famous

Situated at an altitude of around 2,650 meters, Gulmarg Golf Course is counted among the highest golf courses globally. It was originally built during the British era and later redesigned to international standards. Today, it attracts both professional golfers and tourists who simply want to enjoy its breathtaking views.

The vast green landscape, fresh mountain air, and panoramic Himalayan backdrop make it one of the most beautiful golf courses in India.

What Makes Gulmarg Golf Course Special

One of the Highest Golf Courses in the World : Playing golf at this altitude is a unique experience. Even if you don’t play, walking through this massive green meadow feels magical.

Scenic Beauty & Photography : The golf course looks like a painting with rolling green hills, pine forests, and distant snow peaks. It is a perfect photography spot in Gulmarg, especially during summer and autumn.

British-Era Heritage : Built during the colonial period, the course still holds a vintage charm with its clubhouse and old-world vibe.

Peaceful Travel Experience : Unlike crowded tourist spots, Gulmarg Golf Course offers a calm and relaxing atmosphere ideal for nature lovers.

Best Time to Visit Gulmarg Golf Course

Summer (May to September)

  • Best time to visit
  • Lush green views and pleasant weather
  • Ideal for golf and sightseeing

Autumn (October)

  • Golden landscapes and fewer crowds
  • Perfect for photography

Winter (November to March)

  • Covered in snow
  • Golf course turns into a snowfield and ski area
  • Great for snow photography

Entry Fee & Timings

  • Entry Fee: Approx ₹100-₹300 (may vary for tourists)
  • Golf playing charges: Extra for golfers
  • Timings: 10 AM - 6 PM (subject to weather)

  • St. Mary’s Church - Historic British-era church Know more..
  • Strawberry Valley - Hidden scenic valley Know more..
  • Maharani Temple - Famous hilltop temple Know more..

Why Gulmarg Golf Course Should Be on Your Bucket List

Gulmarg Golf Course offers a rare combination of luxury, nature, and peace. From being one of the highest golf courses in the world to offering breathtaking Himalayan views, this place is perfect for travelers who want a calm yet scenic experience in Kashmir. Whether you love photography, nature walks, or simply relaxing in beautiful surroundings, Gulmarg Golf Course deserves a place on your Kashmir travel bucket list.

It offers a peaceful travel experience perfect for nature lovers, photographers, and travelers seeking beauty and calm in Gulmarg. Whether you play golf or just explore, this iconic spot adds charm and elegance to your Kashmir trip.

faqs.question: What is Gulmarg Golf Course famous for?
faqs.answer: Gulmarg Golf Course is famous for being one of the highest golf courses in the world and for its scenic Himalayan views.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Gulmarg Golf Course?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit is from May to September when the course is lush green and weather is pleasant.

faqs.question: Is there an entry fee for Gulmarg Golf Course?
faqs.answer: Yes, tourists usually pay a small entry fee, while golfers have separate playing charges.

faqs.question: Can tourists visit Gulmarg Golf Course without playing golf?
faqs.answer: Yes, visitors can explore, walk, and take photos even if they are not playing golf.

faqs.question: Is Gulmarg Golf Course good for photography?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the best photography spots in Gulmarg with mountains, greenery, and scenic landscapes.
